one_liner: SEO rank tracking and marketing analytics platform with an API for keyword, backlink, and domain data.

auth.evidence_quote: Log in to your SE Ranking account, navigate to the API tab under the Settings section, and retrieve your unique API key.

access.evidence_quote: API is included with every SE Ranking subscription. You can even test it in the free trial account.
access.notes: API is bundled with paid subscriptions ($129/mo Core, $279/mo Growth) or a separate $149/mo add-on / pay-as-you-go; free trial account allows testing only.

api.notes: MCP server hosted on SE Ranking's own domain (seranking.com/mcp.html), qualifying as official/vendor-published. Endpoint count not directly verified against docs' reference index.

verdict.rationale: API key auth with no extra approval gate, but sustained production use requires a paid subscription or API add-on beyond the free trial.
